lines.text: As his death drew near, David charged Solomon to be strong and walk in the LORD's ways.
David said the LORD promised that if his descendants walked faithfully, a man of his line would always sit on Israel's throne.
David told Solomon that Joab had killed Abner and Amasa in peacetime, and to forgive him and let him die in peace.

wrong_details.wrong: forgive him and let him die in peace
wrong_details.true: do not let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace

lines.text: David told Solomon to show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai, who stood by him when he fled from Saul, and to deal with Shimei.
David was buried in the City of David after reigning forty years, and Solomon's kingdom was firmly established.
